profile.headline: Front-end Software Engineer with DevOps and SRE experience
profile.summary: I am passionate about making innovative software that people can use in their everyday lives. I have a strong interest in different web technologies and I'm always happy to learn something new.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote Terraform to initialize and manage compute engine, service accounts, and artifact registry Google Cloud resources to improve services across the Pantheon platform

• Increased SRE adoption within Pantheon engineering squads by collaborating in service maturity assessments and service risk assessments for production services

• Completed 5-week instructor-led Google Cloud Site Reliability Engineer Course to learn SRE principles, practices, cultural tenets, SLO theory, and SLO crafting

• Planned and executed a migration strategy for Pantheon’s containers from Quay.io to Google Artifact Registry, improving availability, permission scopes and decreased hosting costs for the engineering organization

• Participated in on-call engineer rotation, responding to automated alerts and engineer escalations to ensure the stability, reliability, and performance production infrastructure
• Acted as incident commander leading a group of engineers to remediate and communicate platform incidents in an organized and timely fashion

• Presented at company on-site engineering conference about Software Supply Chain Security, explained ways to reduce source, build, and deployment threats in the software development pipeline
• Improved the software deployment pipeline supply chain security of containers by identifying operating system and package security vulnerabilities in container images using Google Cloud API’s
• Instructed security engineering team how to consume cloud container security vulnerability logs using Pantheon’s security information and event management (SIEM) tools

• Led Pantheon’s Black and Latinx Employee resource group, collaborated with members and DEIA manager to organize company-wide events that promoted inclusion, raised cultural awareness and celebrated Black and Latinx communities

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned and maintained a Drupal 7 based web publishing platform supporting more than 1200 websites, 1500 content authors, and more than 2.5 million pageviews per day.

• Built, maintained, and deployed web server configuration for Web Express infrastructure using Ansible.

• Developed and deployed Python REST API’s to Google Cloud Platform used to orchestrate deployments and updates of Drupal 7 instances hosted on-prem and on Pantheon web hosting.

• Collaborated with the development team to improve service performance and capacity with the use of New Relic APM and Kibana.

• Handled after hours service incidents in a timely manner during two-week on-call rotation periods, ensuring Web Express service uptime and reliability.

• Wrote orchestration tools and led the migration of 1000 Drupal 7 websites to cloud web hosting (Pantheon) over the course of three months.

positions.title: Jr. Drupal Developer
positions.description:
WebExpress Team at the Office of Strategic Relations

• Developed new features for Express, a Drupal 7 profile, and custom Drupal modules.
• Built LAMP local development environments for Express using Vagrant and Docker for other members to develop and test code changes.
• Identified and fixed navigation issues in the Express front-end to improve accessibility for screen reader users.
• Set up Travis-CI and Behat testing for all Express modules to minimize bugs in deployments.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research Assistant through the Discovery Learning Apprenticeship through the College of Engineering and Applied Sciences.

• Working with Assistant Professor Shaun Kane in exploring and developing new ways of interacting with 3D printers.
• Organized and planned a user study to better understand the way people perceive 3D printing, as well to better understand the elements of tabletop games improved or augmented with the help of 3D fabrication.
• Co-authored a research paper that was submitted and accepted to ACM Creativity and Cognition Conference. Fabrication Games: using 3D printers to explore new interactions for tabletop games. Proceedings of Creativity and Cognition ’17, 51- 62. (acceptance rate 29%)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Web development, Database Administration, Filemaker PHP integration. Currently developing a FileMaker PHP solution for student workers to access payroll timesheets electronically without having to use a computer connected to the local server.
positions.insights: Web Accessibility Testing and Web Design

positions.description: Helping CSCI 1300 students to increase comprehension of topics presented within the course and on assignments
